mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -39.1% (t-2w) to -28.3% (t-0w), a 10.8 percentage point recovery over two weeks. This sustained upward trend in retail mobility indicates a structural shift toward reopening behavior that will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC higher than the prior 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 10.8 points over t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the mean of the prior 28 days, or declines week-on-week in 3 of the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has recovered from -28.7% (t-2w) to -16.7% (t-0w), a 12-point improvement. Increased transit usage signals commuter confidence and foot traffic to retail hubs. When TRANSIT exceeds -20% for two consecutive weeks, retail recovery accelerates within the following two weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 14 days despite TRANSIT remaining above -20%, or TRANSIT falls below -20% in week t+1.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the prior 28-day mean, or GROCERY_PHARM reverts below -10% within two weeks.
